title: introduce mini-burst skein runner with slot-aware KV slab checkpointer and compact attribution reporter
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Production traces show frequent short correlated bursts (8-64 token bursts) across cohorts that cause transient KV pressure and cold-path kernel invocations. Existing runners either focus on long sessions or synthetic uniform arrivals; we lacked a compact, reproducible runner that exercises slot-level KV checkpointing and produces small, signal-rich attribution traces. This PR adds the 'mini-burst skein' runner to the benchmark harness, a slot-aware KV slab checkpointer to emulate lightweight checkpoint/eviction cycles, and a compact attribution reporter that samples per-kernel at low rate to keep telemetry costs manageable. Changes: - bench/runners/mini_burst_skein.py: new runner that generates correlated mini-bursts across N parallel sessions, configurable slot windows, and ttl semantics. - bench/sim/kv_slab.py: slot-aware KV slab checkpointer that mimics slab allocation and checkpoint boundaries observed in our dedicated clusters. - bench/reporters/compact_attribution.py: lightweight reporter emitting per-kernel attribution (cpu_ms, gpu_ms, kv_ops) sampled 1/1000 by default and compressed with a simple delta-encoder. - bench/profiles/mini_burst_profile.yaml: canonical profile used by CI small-run. - tests/test_mini_burst_runner.py: unit + integration harness tests exercising determinism and sampler behaviour. - docs/bench/mini-burst-runner.md: usage and how to reproduce the trace artifacts locally. Motivation checklist: - [x] unit tests - [x] integration with the benchmark harness - [x] baseline traces uploaded to artifacts - [x] docs and reproducible example How to run locally: python -m bench.run --runner mini_burst_skein --profile bench/profiles/mini_burst_profile.yaml --samples 1000 Expected signal: reproduces transient KV eviction windows and increases cold-path kernel hit-rate in short bursts which helps attribute tail latency to eviction pressure. Bench summary (internal microcluster, mixed workload 70/30 seq/priming, single-run median): - cold-path kernel invocations: +12% vs uniform-sampler baseline - per-sample telemetry size: ~18KB (compact reporter) - attribution S/N ratio: ~3.5x improvement vs naive sampling Notes: this runner is intentionally conservative in telemetry volume; the slab checkpointer parameters are tunable and default to a small footprint to avoid CI OOMs. Related: informs ENG-1023 (kv-observability), ENG-1585 (burst-synthetic-workloads).

review_comments: Diego Ramirez: Nice focused addition. Two asks: make RNG seed deterministic by default for CI reproducibility, and prefer typed signatures for the slab APIs.

release_notes: Add mini-burst skein runner to benchmark-lab: a compact, slot-aware burst generator with a lightweight KV slab checkpointer and compact attribution reporter for low-noise telemetry. Useful for reproducing short correlated bursts and attributing transient kernel pressure.
notes_for_ops: Default reporter sampling rate is 1/1000 and slab defaults target a small memory footprint. Override via bench/profiles/mini_burst_profile.yaml for larger experiments. Watch for disk-buffering when samples >100k.
